subject: Private offer: bundle anchor + reseller margin concession
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@clearwave.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rex Tanner <rex@distco.com>
Date: 2028-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer request — bundle pricing and channel margin

Hi Mina / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the ClearWave team is keen to move forward with a private offer for the ‘Streamline’ bundle (inference + embeddings + ops). Procurement asked for a consolidated SKU and a single commit number to keep our internal procurement simple. A few asks: 

- Target ARR for our first year: $450k (list price)
- Needed upfront discount to get internal approval: ~28% off list
- Reseller channel (DistCo) needs a minimum 20% net margin on their portion to route the deal through their reseller program
- Standard 12-month term, monthly metered billing

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) map the bundle to a single private-offer SKU, 2) hit ~28% off list for the committed volume, and 3) allow the 20% reseller margin pass-through (we can provide reseller PO and terms)?

We attached a Draft MPA for reference (ClearWave_MPA_draft.pdf). Happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow if needed.

Best,
Asha
Procurement Manager
ClearWave AI

[Attachment: ClearWave_MPA_draft.pdf]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — bundle pricing and channel margin

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear ask and the MPA. Short answer: we can create a single private-offer SKU for the Streamline bundle, but there are a couple of trade-offs we need to align on.

Key points:
- We can meet a consolidated private-offer structure for $450k list mapped to one SKU.
- 28% off list is aggressive for that volume on Hosted pricing; to get that level we need either a firm upfront commit (prepay or reserve) or allow a modest uplift to the model latency SLOs (i.e., route to Dedicated capacity) — both impact our unit economics.
- Reseller margin: we generally allow reseller pass-throughs but need clarity on whether the 20% is on list or on net (post-discount). If it’s on net, that materially affects our accepted discount band.

Action items for me/us:
1) Ben — can you outline two pricing scenarios in the attached SKU workbook (redwood_bundle_SKUs_v2.xlsx): A) 28% net discount with a 12% reseller pass-through capped at $54k, but requiring 30% upfront reserve; B) 22% net discount with 20% reseller pass-through on list, no upfront reserve.
2) Irene — can you confirm whether we can support monthly metered billing under scenario A if the customer prepays 30%?

Asha — can you confirm whether ClearWave’s reseller margin expectation is on list or post-discount? Also, if procurement can do a 30% partial prepay, it unlocks the deeper discount.

I’m available for a 30m call this afternoon between 3–5pm PT if that helps.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Lead, Cloud Marketplace
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_bundle_SKUs_v2.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@clearwave.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-16T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — bundle pricing and channel margin

Asha — following up with the two scenarios Mina asked for; high level here so you can react before I send the workbook with line-level math.

Scenario A (deeper discount, partial prepay):
- List ARR: $450,000
- Discount: 28% off list
- Customer pay terms: 30% prepaid at signing, remaining billed monthly
- Reseller pass-through: 12% of list (capped $54,000) paid to DistCo
- Redwood net: roughly $275k ARR delivered across the year (after pass-through and discount)
- Why it works: prepay reduces liquidity risk and lets us allocate Reserved capacity for latency guarantees.

Scenario B (shallower discount, no prepay):
- Discount: 22% off list
- Reseller margin: 20% of list routed to DistCo (no cap)
- Monthly metered billing, no prepay
- Redwood net: roughly $288k ARR after pass-through and discount (higher than A because pass-through is on list but discount is smaller)

Callouts: If ClearWave insists on 28% and 20% reseller margin post-discount, Redwood net drops below our acceptable floor unless we push the customer to Dedicated or change term length.

Next step: Asha, which scenario is closer to approval? If neither, tell us the nonnegotiable items (reseller margin structure vs prepay vs discount level) and we’ll try another combintation.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Cloud Marketplace
Redwood Inference

From: Asha Patel <asha@clearwave.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Rex Tanner <rex@distco.com>, ClearWave Procurement <procurement@clearwave.ai>
Date: 2028-08-18T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — bundle pricing and channel margin

Ben / Mina — thanks for the fast turn. We reviewed both scenarios internally and here’s the counter: 

- ClearWave can do Scenario A (30% prepay) but we need the reseller margin to be calculable as 20% of the net paid to the reseller (i.e., 20% of the customer’s net spend after Redwood’s discount). Our finance team argues that reseller payouts are managed on net receipts.
- Alternatively, if Redwood insists the reseller margin is on list, ClearWave will accept Scenario B only if the discount moves to 24% (instead of 22%) and we get a 60-day invoice term.

Our preference is to keep the reseller payment on net (it keeps DistCo whole and simplifies our reconciliation). If Redwood can accept Scenario A with 20% of net to DistCo, we’ll sign the MPA and request the private-offer SKU and a DocuSign link.

We’ve looped in Rex from DistCo to confirm he’s comfortable receiving 20% of net receipts (Rex — can you confirm?).

Next steps:
- Redwood: confirm which scenario you accept (A with 20% of net OR B with 24% discount + 60-day term)
- Once agreed, Mina please provide private-offer SKU and DocuSign link and we’ll route the PO.

Appreciate the flexibility — happy to jump on a 15m call if easier.

Best,
Asha Patel
Procurement Manager
ClearWave AI

[Attachment: ClearWave_MPA_draft.pdf]
